C-5.Name: Investigate and stabilize the intermittent pinch-zoom timing test
C-5.Summary: During C-2 verification the full renderer suite intermittently failed a single timing-sensitive test: tests/renderer/pages/app-deep.test.js, "pinch-to-zoom handler > accumulates delta below threshold without emitting" — observed twice across six full-suite runs under heavy machine load (concurrent builds/tests), never reproducing on retry, always in that same suite. Marked for additional verification so the flake is either fixed or explicitly quarantined. NOT IMPLEMENTED YET — planning artifact only.

Problem.Description: One timing-sensitive test fails rarely under load; CI stability is at risk on slow runners.
Problem.RootCause: Suspected real-timer dependence in the pinch-zoom accumulation test (delta threshold accumulation vs emitted zoom events); not yet reproduced in isolation.

Goals.R-1: Reproduce deterministically: loop the suite (≥20 runs, with parallel load) and capture the failure output; confirm it is timing and not state leakage between tests.
Goals.R-2: Stabilize: switch the accumulation assertions to fake timers (vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTime) or make the threshold assertion load-tolerant — whichever matches the handler's actual debounce semantics.
Goals.R-3: If the handler itself (not the test) is racy under load, document the race and open a followup; do not mask a real bug with a looser test.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not relax the pinch-zoom behavior contract; only the test's timing sensitivity is in scope.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Any change to zoom behavior or thresholds.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: 20 consecutive full-suite runs (or targeted suite loop under artificial load) with zero failures of this test.
Root cause noted in the test file comment: fake timers vs load-tolerance vs handler race.

C-5.VerificationIntent: Repeated-run stability evidence (command with run count in the plan) plus the standard renderer suite gate.

Approval.ApprovalScope: Planning only; investigation is a future session.

Evidence.Item: The flaky test named in the Summary no longer exists: C-15 Phase W replaced the pinch-zoom handler with a synchronous ctrl+wheel accumulator (app.vue setupCtrlWheelFontSize), so the accumulation assertion has no timer in its path.
R-1: 20 consecutive runs of tests/renderer/pages/app-deep.test.js while two full renderer suites ran in parallel: 0 failures.
R-2: the one remaining wall-clock assertion in the suite (persist debounce, real 220 ms wait vs 150 ms debounce) now uses fake timers and pins both edges (149 ms no write, 150 ms one write).
R-3: no handler race found. Full renderer suite: 242 files, 3279 tests passed.

Completion.Note: The zoom-keys suite in the same file still waits 220 ms of real time for the same debounce. It is outside this change's scope and is safe by timer ordering, but could take the same fake-timer treatment.
